title: HealBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Evaluating Psychological Comfort in Text-to-Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27516v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite advances in photorealism, semantic fidelity, and aesthetics, text-to-image generation and image editing remain understudied in a human-centered dimension: whether their outputs feel psychologically comforting. Grounded in cognitive evaluation theory, we define psychological comfort as an affective response shaped by viewers' appraisal of restorative and emotionally supportive visual cues. We introduce HealBench, a fine-grained benchmark of 30,000 high-quality image-text pairs spanning 19 categories and 92 subcategories, selected from 100,000 candidates through a human- and expert-in-the-loop pipeline combining vision-language model matching, human preference models, expert filtering, and exemplar-guided augmentation. We also construct HealBench-Eval, a feature-clustered evaluation set of 1,095 instances. Using HealBench-Eval, we conduct objective and subjective evaluations of 14 representative image generation models and prompt

translated_title: HealBench：用于评估文本到图像生成中心理舒适度的细粒度基准
translated_abstract: 尽管在照片级真实感、语义保真度和美学方面取得了进展，文本到图像生成和图像编辑在一个以人为中心的维度上仍未得到充分研究：即其输出能否带来心理上的慰藉。基于认知评价理论，我们将心理舒适度定义为一种情感反应，它由观者对具有恢复性和情感支持性的视觉线索的评估所塑造。我们提出了HealBench，这是一个包含30,000对高质量图文对的细粒度基准，涵盖19个类别和92个子类别，这些数据从100,000个候选样本中通过一个人机与专家协同的流程筛选而来，该流程结合了视觉-语言模型匹配、人类偏好模型、专家筛选以及范例引导增强。我们还构建了HealBench-Eval，这是一个包含1,095个实例的特征聚类评估集。利用HealBench-Eval，我们对14个代表性图像生成模型及提示进行了客观与主观评估。
tldr: 本文提出了HealBench——首个面向文本到图像生成心理舒适度评估的细粒度基准，包含涵盖19个类别和92个子类别的30,000对高质量图文数据，并通过人机与专家协同流程构建了1,095个实例的评估集，对14个代表性模型进行了客观与主观评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HealBench, the first fine-grained benchmark of 30,000 high-quality image-text pairs across 19 categories and 92 subcategories for evaluating psychological comfort in text-to-image generation, along with a feature-clustered evaluation set of 1,095 instances used to objectively and subjectively assess 14 representative models.
